analysis.strategyReview: Our content strategy shows strong coverage across all five pillars with 76 published posts. We have excellent depth in Channel Tactics (phone, email, direct mail, door knocking) and solid Vertical Playbooks for major industries. However, we have gaps in advanced Metrics & Optimization content and Role Guides for specific positions beyond basic agent guidance. Our Compliance coverage is strong for TCPA and Medicare but lacks depth in other regulatory areas. The unpublished calendar shows good balance but needs more timely, seasonal content for Q2/summer selling cycles.
analysis.competitiveInsights: AgedLeadStore.com focuses heavily on product features and basic lead descriptions but lacks strategic implementation guidance. HowToWorkLeads.com provides generic advice without industry-specific nuances. We have clear differentiation with our vertical-specific playbooks and compliance focus. Current keyword opportunities include 'aged lead ROI calculation,' 'lead aging impact on conversion,' 'summer insurance sales strategy,' and 'aged lead team management.' Trending searches show increased interest in AI integration, multi-channel attribution, and seasonal sales strategies as agents prepare for summer selling seasons.
